about: install-global-hooks points git's global core.hooksPath at a directory of shims to the dispatcher, refuses to replace another, names each repository a local core.hooksPath keeps out, and --check tells installed from not. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE install-global-hooks.py tests/test_global_hooks.py tests/mutants/jpt-scratch-on-install-global-hooks.json

mutants.name: another global hooks path is replaced
mutants.target: another global core.hooksPath: NOT_RUN, refused, naming it

mutants.name: an uncovered repository exits OK
edits: return jpexit.FINDINGS if uncovered else jpexit.OK
